meta.title: Save and invest in Swiss francs with Frankencoin
meta.description: Earn the protocol savings rate on ZCHF or own a share of the reserve with FCS. Live figures, calculator and a three-step start.

hero.title: A Swiss-franc account that lives on-chain.
hero.subtitle: No bank, no issuer, no counterparty. Your ZCHF earns the rate set by the protocol, and FCS lets you own the system itself.

compare.title: Save or invest?
compare.subtitle: Both start with ZCHF. They differ in risk and in what you own.

rows.label: What you hold
rows.invest: FCS, a share of the reserve

rows.label: Can it fall?
rows.save: No, unless the whole system fails
rows.invest: Yes, when the reserve absorbs losses

rows.label: Exit
rows.invest: Sell on market, or redeem after 90 days

cards.title: Borrowers pay
cards.description: Anyone can mint ZCHF against collateral. They pay interest upfront into the reserve pool.

cards.title: Savers are paid first
cards.description: The savings module pays the governance-set rate from that pool, before anything goes to shareholders.

cards.title: Shareholders own the rest
cards.description: Whatever stays in the pool raises the value of FCS. Losses, if any, are absorbed by the pool too.

sticky.label: Start now
sticky.sub: Save or invest in three steps
